package com.example; import java.util.List; /** * A demo class. * @author pier */ public class Demo implements Runnable { private static final String NAME = "pier"; private final int count = 42; private final double ratio = 1.5e-3; private final char c = 'x'; @Override public void run() { List<String> items = List.of(NAME, "a", "b"); for (String item : items) { System.out.println(item + count + ratio + c); } } record Point(int x, int y) {} }
